name: FlexInput Virtual Media Keys
notes: Plain-HID Consumer Control (FunctionMode 0, no companion): the media and volume keys, which a keyboard sends on the Consumer page (0x0C) rather than the Keyboard page the hm-keyboard boot report carries. 4-byte report: two 16-bit usage slots (an array, 0 = none), so two media keys can be held at once (volume up while muted, say). No Report ID, so hm-keyboard's descriptor and report stay exactly as they were - a third node beside it instead, the way a real keyboard exposes media keys as a second collection. Windows' inbox HID stack turns these usages into the media VKs / volume control. Reports are built directly by flexinput-virtual's keymouse_hm and published via HidMaestroDevice::write_raw_input. VID 0x1209 / PID 0xF1E7: pid.codes space, unregistered, inside the 0xF1E0-0xF1EF family the physical-input listeners treat as FlexInput's own. Own device container (ownContainer), same index as the keyboard and mouse, so the three show up as one device.
